subject: MdeModulePkg/Library: ArmFfaLib: add mapping ARM_FFA_RET_RETRY
reasons: Adds a single case to each of two switch statements in one file (ArmFfaCommon.c), mapping ARM_FFA_RET_RETRY to EFI_TIMEOUT and vice versa

Only two insertion points, both in the same file; while the pattern of adding a case to both conversion functions is symmetric, the scope is too narrow (one enum value, one file) to be a meaningful Coccinelle candidate
No cross-file or cross-package repetition; no evidence of a broader collateral evolution series that would justify automation
